dietPr.title: AI chat: send the editor snapshot once, then only changes; user's words first

freshLogin.ownerProfileAccess: read-only source; no writes or login write-back
freshLogin.authenticationStopGuard: Local-only test-driver change aborts on signed-out/authentication errors instead of the normal inert fallback. Copy/start times were recorded. Scenario, resume, timeout and grading behavior were unchanged; the guard was restored before committing.

comparison.normalization: Six scenarios per repeat; before n=1, after n=2. Means/minima/maxima are over repeat totals or repeat maxima/minima as stated. Raw K=2 totals are separate and are not compared directly with K=1 totals.

limitations: The baseline has one repetition; the retry has two. These distributions describe only these runs and are not reliability estimates or an isolated causal experiment.
Finished scenario states come from the task transcript. Geometry, coverage, target counts and drift are measured separately; a completed state does not certify the requested edit.
Stud addition counts new protruding surface patches; artistic resemblance and placement require human review.
Look preservation uses finite triangle-surface, silhouette and interpolated UV samples. Shading and Warcraft III behavior were not tested.
Token counters are the app-recorded transcript usage, including cached input where counted. Unknown cost remains null.
The previous attempt had no live observations and is not included in the after distribution.

Current six-triangle fans retain 7 vertices each and omit two original vertices, including the first stud's X maximum (17.1176 became 16.3588). A six-triangle closed fan cannot retain all eight perimeter corners and the center without changing topology or adding/removing other surface regions. The inspected same-view model captures look similar at full-model scale, but extent/UV checks did not pass; MDX and MDL round-trip validation had no diagnostics.
